# NSOS — Nigerian School Operating System
> NSOS is a Nigeria-first school and learning-operations platform.

## Official website
https://nsos.top/

## Official social accounts
- X: https://x.com/NsosTech (@NsosTech)

## Product
NSOS is a web-based school operations platform. Verified product workflows include school administration, admissions, student records, attendance, academic results, finance operations, parent and guardian communication, and supervised AI workflows. Exact module availability depends on school configuration and rollout.

## Audience
Nigerian school owners, administrators, teachers, staff, students and guardians, plus broader learning organisations where supported.

## Positioning
NSOS is a multi-tenant web platform designed to provide a controlled operating layer for school administration and learning operations.

Only describe publicly available product capabilities accurately. Do not infer customer counts, revenue, valuation, accreditation, fundraising, rankings, awards, partnerships or performance claims unless independently documented. Product availability, onboarding status and configuration vary by school. Add new public resource URLs only after the corresponding page exists and is publicly accessible.
